releaseNotes: Self-update installer repaired: native cf-updater-helper.exe replaces broken .mjs helper.
Helper is a standalone Windows EXE (Rust, no Node.js required) — runs after app exits.
Granular install-error messages: missing helper, copy failed, launch failed, rollback.
Technical Details collapsible in Settings → About when an install error occurs.
Packaging assertion: cf-updater-helper.exe verified present in win-unpacked/resources.
